source_module_zip_validation: SHA-256 and Go Hash1 recomputed for 105 common ZIPs from the local module cache; exact H1 matches platform binaries. Linux-only archives are pinned by binary H1 and were copied with exact LICENSE members. Windows-only archives were downloaded from proxy.golang.org and match binary build-info H1. No dependency was installed.
windows_main_module_h1: The Windows binary reports module version v2.18.0 but its main-module H1 field is blank; source identity is inferred from matching version/path and the Linux H1 for the same module version, not cryptographically proven from Windows binary.
